import json, re, random, chess, sys, time
R = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open("re.json"))]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in R: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
def ref(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
ex = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
n = 0; t = time.time()
for g in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 200):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 300:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            fen = b.fen(); ours = run(fen); r = ref(fen); n += 1
            ok = len(ours) == len(r) and all(x in r or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in r for x in ours)
            if not ok:
                print("FAIL", fen); print(sorted(set(ours)-r)); print(sorted(r-set(ours))); sys.exit(1)
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        caps = [m for m in ms if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion or b.is_castling(m)]
        b.push(random.choice(caps if caps and random.random()<0.5 else ms))
print("ok", n, time.time()-t)
EOF
python3 test.py 0 100
